_note: Crusnik 40% form. The blood meter appears once 'meterFlag' is set (Sister Paula, the first mini boss) and fills only with Methuselah blood: per-enemy 'blood' in enemies.json (hit, kill), and 'bossBlood' here for Methuselah bosses. Transforming needs 'unlockFlag' (Abel's first transformation, in the Kampfer fight). When full, ABIL transforms him; while transformed the meter drains; at zero he returns to the priest form. In Crusnik form ABIL throws the chain lash. Times in ms, speeds px/s.

bossBlood._note: Methuselah bosses: blood per landed hit, by boss id.
